title: Coda · six returns
notes: Institutional coda for The Full Peal.

lines.text: Six strikes arrive at the gate together. The cathedral tower remains still against the morning.
The monitor prints two body signatures and files both under RETURN.
Neither man reaches the south porch.
The guard opens the ledger to the right-hand column and finds both names already entered.
There is no box for the distinction he is making.
At 06:00 the full peal is accepted as a complete return.
